clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, greater thunderhawks yield a gland prized by Brewmaster Drohn. He needs it to recreate Chen Stormstout's fiery Trogg Ale.

Greater thunderhawks hunt across the Barrens' arid savannas. These winged serpents are known for harnessing storms, and the older, more dangerous ones produce a saliva gland charged with natural potency. Travelers keep clear of the deadly beasts, but brewmasters value the gland as a rare base for exotic drinks.

Brewmaster Drohn settled outside Ratchet after Chen Stormstout traveled through Kalimdor. Drohn studies the wandering brewmaster's fermentation methods and needs a fresh thunderhawk saliva gland, stormhide lightning glands, and kodo liver to brew Trogg Ale. The fiery spirit has an unmistakable kick and is meant to fortify hardy adventurers.
